evidence: rule_sets.py:405-428 select_rule_set raises RuleSetRequestError for each of five classes (key missing/empty :415; no such set :419; account not bound :422; user id invalid :425; set unconfirmed :427). query_database.py:641 calls select_rule_set(rule_sets, strip_reserved_metadata(metadata)) and re-raises RuleSetRequestError (:642-644). strip_reserved_metadata (:129-143) drops only RESERVED_METADATA_KEYS = {starter_ui_request, ui_features_available} (config.py:607), so rule-set keys are kept (rule_sets.py:107 also rejects reserved names as keys). server.py:246-257 _request_metadata returns {} for >64 keys, which yields the key-missing refusal (fail-closed). In server.py:366-393 the tool only catches AgentRunError; RuleSetRequestError (a RuntimeError, rule_sets.py:345) propagates to FastMCP, which formats tool exceptions as isError results (server.py:363 notes the 'Error executing tool' framework prefix).
